hypothesis: The fmt.printf/fmt.fprintf interpolation splice serializes its cooked format string with Rust Debug, unlike the ordinary interpolation path which uses go_quote. Valid control characters such as NUL and BEL therefore emit invalid Go escapes. This is a buildability issue, not a demonstrated data-race or memory-safety issue.
